# Anthropic News — captured 2026-05-25

## May 22, 2026 — Project Glasswing: An initial update
- Initiative to secure the world's most critical software for the AI era
- Originally introduced April 7, 2026, powered by Claude Mythos Preview
- Has uncovered 10,000+ high-or-critical-severity vulnerabilities across widely used software
- Cloudflare: ~2,000 bugs (400 H/C severity), fewer false positives than human-led testing
- Mozilla: 271 vulnerabilities fixed in Firefox 150 — more effective than earlier runs with Claude Opus 4.6
- Open-source scanning: 1,000+ projects, 6,202 H/C-severity vulnerabilities; 90.6% confirmed legitimate
- Expansion plan: working with "critical partners" including U.S. and allied governments
- Verizon joined Project Glasswing
